Title: Attached photos and files are SILENTLY DISCARDED on submit; record stored with no attachments and the user is told it succeeded
App / Module / Page: Portal - all intake forms, evidence/photo step
Journey: Attach photographic evidence to a report
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open /portal/report/near-miss and complete steps 1 and 2  2. On What Happened, attach files via Upload Photos  3. Confirm they are listed in the UI  4. Complete the required narrative fields and press Submit
Expected: The attached evidence is uploaded and stored against the report
Actual: Four files were attached (a 25 KB JPEG, a text file, a 6.8 MB JPEG, and the 25 KB JPEG again) and all four were listed in the UI. Submission succeeded with Submitted Successfully! Your reference number is: NM-2026-6D3DE96F. Not one byte of the files was sent. Proven at three independent layers on the same submission. UI: all four listed immediately before Submit. NETWORK: window.fetch AND XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open both instrumented across the entire submit - exactly one non-GET request fired, POST /api/v1/portal/reports/ returning 201, with bodyKind json, bodyBytes 1098, fileNames empty. No FormData, no multipart, no file parts, and no separate upload call before, during or after; 1098 bytes of JSON cannot contain a 6.8 MB photograph. STORED RECORD: GET /api/v1/near-misses/ for NM-2026-6D3DE96F (id 102) returns attachments: null. The model HAS an attachments field, so the schema supports evidence - the client never sends it. On an HSEQ platform the photograph is frequently the most valuable artefact on the record: investigation, RIDDOR, client audit pack, insurance. A fitter photographs a failed lifting eye, attaches it, sees it listed, presses Submit, is congratulated by name and given a reference number, and the photograph does not exist anywhere. Not recoverable - the only copy was in browser memory.
Repro Rate: 1/1 executed, corroborated independently at network and database layers; second UI repro pending
Evidence: Instrumented fetch+XHR capture of the full submit; success screen with reference NM-2026-6D3DE96F; API record showing attachments:null; UI file list captured pre-submit

Title: Photo/file upload has no size, type or count validation
Journey: Attach photographic evidence to a report
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open a portal intake form  2. Reach the evidence step  3. Attach files
Expected: Client-side size, type and count limits with clear feedback, and downscaling of large photos before upload
Actual: The shipped input is: <input type=file accept={field_type===image ? image/* : undefined} multiple onChange={s => c([...j, ...Array.from(s.target.files)])} class=hidden />. The handler appends every selected file unconditionally. No file-size check - the byte constant 1024*1024 appears ZERO times across all 15 deployed bundles. No file-type validation - accept is only an advisory picker filter and is bypassed by choosing All Files, and where field_type is not image accept is undefined so any file type is taken with no check at all. No count limit despite multiple. No duplicate detection - selecting the same file twice appends it twice. A modern phone photo is 5-12 MB; four photos of a damaged hydraulic line is a 20-50 MB multipart POST over 4G in a yard with no size warning and no confirmable client-side downscaling - and per PX-300 the draft does not survive the failure. This is the most likely real-world failure mode of the portal flagship journey. VERIFIED IN CODE, not functionally executed; API behaviour under a large payload is NOT TESTED.
Evidence: Deployed bundle: full file input and onChange handler quoted above; zero occurrences of a byte-size constant

Title: Form step renders completely blank when the tab loses visibility mid-transition, with Continue still enabled
Journey: Any portal report journey interrupted mid-step
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Begin a portal intake form  2. Press Continue  3. Background the tab (phone locks, incoming call, switch to camera app) during the step transition
Expected: Content mounts regardless of animation state; animations complete immediately when the document is hidden
Actual: The outgoing panel is left at opacity:0 transform:translateX(20px), the incoming panel never mounts, and the user sees a completely empty form step - stepper showing 2 Location & Time, progress bar advanced, Continue enabled, nothing in between. Screenshot captured in a real browser. One WAAPI animation sits running at currentTime 0; requestAnimationFrame never fires, so the transition completion callback never runs and AnimatePresence never swaps children. Mobile browsers throttle animation frames in backgrounded tabs by exactly this mechanism, so a fitter whose phone locks or who takes a call mid-form is in the same state - and per PX-300 their draft is gone if they reload. Fix: complete or skip animations when document.hidden, and never gate content mounting on an animation completing.
Evidence: evidence/PX-329-blank-step-panel-context.jpg plus computed-style captures of the stalled panel and getAnimations() state
